title: Replace "plasmashell" with "Plasma" in the warning about shortcut already in use
line: The shortcut conflict warning now says an action belongs to "Plasma Workspace" instead of "plasmashell".
explanation: plasmashell created its KAboutData with an empty display name, so anything that names the application (like KGlobalAccel's shortcut conflict dialog) fell back to the technical name "plasmashell". The change, taken from Nate's draft MR plasma-workspace!6047, sets the display name to "Plasma Workspace" and replaces the "Plasma Shell" short description with a descriptive one.

commits.message:
shell: give KAboutData a display name and a real description

Without a display name plasmashell fell back to its technical name, so
for example the shortcut conflict warning said an action belonged to
"plasmashell". Set the display name and a more descriptive summary.

BUG: 511085

patches.diff:
From 1bddddceb2cf138c46b55bd69b2bf9e0ffdd088f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 02:18:03 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] shell: give KAboutData a display name and a real description

Without a display name plasmashell fell back to its technical name, so
for example the shortcut conflict warning said an action belonged to
"plasmashell". Set the display name and a more descriptive summary.

BUG: 511085
---
 shell/main.cpp | 6 +++++-
 1 file changed, 5 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/shell/main.cpp b/shell/main.cpp
index ce385db4e4..ff4f55b2b2 100644
--- a/shell/main.cpp
+++ b/shell/main.cpp
@@ -129,7 +129,11 @@ int main(int argc, char *argv[])
     // This does not make much sense for plasmashell.
     app.removeLibraryPath(QCoreApplication::applicationDirPath());
 
-    KAboutData aboutData(QStringLiteral("plasmashell"), QString(), QStringLiteral(PROJECT_VERSION), i18n("Plasma Shell"), KAboutLicense::GPL);
+    KAboutData aboutData(QStringLiteral("plasmashell"),
+                         i18nc("@info marketing name of the KDE Plasma desktop/mobile environment's base component", "Plasma Workspace"),
+                         QStringLiteral(PROJECT_VERSION),
+                         i18nc("@info short description of what KDE Plasma is", "Graphical desktop environment"),
+                         KAboutLicense::GPL);
 
     KAboutData::setApplicationData(aboutData);
     KCrash::initialize();
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Conflict warning names the action's owner as "plasmashell" (sweep tester, master)
Same steps with the fix: the owner is now "Plasma Workspace"

review.text: Straightforward fix from Nate's open MR plasma-workspace!6047 that gives plasmashell's KAboutData a proper translated display name ('Plasma Workspace') and description after KLocalizedString::setApplicationDomain is set. This replaces the technical 'plasmashell' fallback in KGlobalAccel's shortcut conflict dialog without altering applicationName, config paths, or D-Bus identifiers. The expected ' — Plasma Workspace' dialog title suffix is clearly documented and verified in the before/after screenshots.

reviews.text: Straightforward fix from Nate's open MR plasma-workspace!6047 that gives plasmashell's KAboutData a proper translated display name ('Plasma Workspace') and description after KLocalizedString::setApplicationDomain is set. This replaces the technical 'plasmashell' fallback in KGlobalAccel's shortcut conflict dialog without altering applicationName, config paths, or D-Bus identifiers. The expected ' — Plasma Workspace' dialog title suffix is clearly documented and verified in the before/after screenshots.

The empty KAboutData display name is the real cause: KGlobalAccel's conflict text uses the application display name, and setting it in shell/main.cpp is the right, minimal place (it also improves the component name in the Shortcuts KCM and DrKonqi). Before/after shots show 'of plasmashell' becoming 'of Plasma Workspace', which satisfies the reporter's request for a user-friendly name; 'Plasma Workspace' covers both desktop and mobile shells. The visible side effect, Qt appending ' — Plasma Workspace' to every plasmashell window title, is disclosed and matches the usual KDE 'Title — App' convention. Commit message and explanation match the diff.
